# netactuate_cloud_floating_ipv4 (Resource)

Manages a Cloud Floating IPv4.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_cloud_floating_ipv4" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID to associate when the floating IPv4 address is created.

### Optional

- `ptr_domain` (String) PTR domain to assign when the floating IPv4 address is created.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Floating IPv4 address.
- `assigned_on` (String) Floating IPv4 assignment timestamp. The API field is spelled AssignedOn.
- `floating_ipv4_id` (Number) Floating IPv4 ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_cloud_floating_ipv4.example 12345
```
